findings.text: The submitted source text explicitly lists plan_id as SYN-H0003-00X, but it was changed to SYN-H0003-001 based only on plan_name matching a catalog, without quoted source evidence showing the applicant intended or selected the new plan ID. This alters applicant-submitted enrollment data rather than correcting from source-document evidence.

The accepted enrollment changed plan_id from the applicant-selected value to a different value, but the timeline provides no quoted documentary evidence tying SYN-H0001-002 to the source form or any catalog record. The only cited evidence repeats the original submitted plan selection '(SYN-H0001-00X)', so the correction is unsupported by the recorded case evidence.
